map.食材替代查询器，输入食材搜索可替代方案或查看替换建议与比例，解决缺料时的烹饪替代: Ingredient substitute lookup: enter an ingredient to search for alternatives or to see substitution suggestions and ratios, solving cooking substitutions when an ingredient is missing.
map.做蛋糕发现没淡奶油/黄油，查替代方案（如牛奶+油替淡奶油、植物油替黄油）并看用量: When baking and finding no light cream or butter, look up substitutes (such as milk plus oil for light cream, vegetable oil for butter) and check the amount and taste difference, so the half-finished product is not wasted.
map.家人过敏（如鸡蛋、麸质、坚果）或素食需求，查可替代食材与注意事项，尽量保留菜品结: For family allergies (such as eggs, gluten or nuts) or vegetarian needs, look up substitute ingredients and precautions, keeping the structure and flavor of the dish as much as possible.
map.季节性或地域缺货（如某种香料、时蔬），查风味相近的本地替代，保持菜式可操作。: For seasonal or regional shortages (such as a particular spice or seasonal vegetable), look for a local substitute with a similar flavor to keep the dish workable.
map.没有泡打粉怎么办: What if there is no baking powder?
map.：每 1 茶匙泡打粉 ≈ 1/4 茶匙小苏打 + 1/2 茶匙塔塔粉（或等量酸奶: : Each 1 teaspoon of baking powder is about 1/4 teaspoon baking soda plus 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar (or replace part of the liquid with an equal amount of yogurt or lemon juice); halve the baking soda to avoid an alkaline taste, and it must be activated by an acidic ingredient.
map.替代后用量要等比吗？: Must the amount be proportionally equal after substitution?
map.多数不等比。如黄油→植物油约 0.8 倍量、泡打粉→小苏打约 1/4 量，需结合: Most are not equal in amount. For example butter to vegetable oil is about 0.8 times, and baking powder to baking soda about one quarter; combine this with the recipe and the acid-base balance, and the tool gives common approximations.
map.过敏替代要注意什么？: What should be watched when substituting for allergies?
map.确认交叉过敏源（如坚果油、乳制品残留），素食替代注意隐藏动物成分（如明胶、鱼露）: Confirm cross-reactive allergens (such as nut oils and dairy residues); for vegetarian substitutes watch for hidden animal ingredients (such as gelatin and fish sauce), and label when necessary to avoid accidental consumption.
map.替代会影响口感吗？: Will the substitute affect the taste?
map.通常会。如植物油替黄油少了奶香与起酥感，牛奶替淡奶油稀了些；属风味/质地取舍，按: Usually yes. For example, vegetable oil instead of butter loses the milky aroma and shortening effect, and milk instead of light cream is thinner; these are flavor and texture trade-offs, so choose based on how tolerant the dish is.
